directive_events.owner_directive: Plan: one pure fingerprint function over numpy arrays, pandas frames/series/indexes, lists, tuples, dicts, sets, strings, bytes and numbers; one declared budget dataclass holding the cost constant and the sample size; strided full-extent sampling above the bound; identity fallback marked unobservable for every other type; numpy, pandas and xxhash imported lazily inside the fingerprint per FR-035.

docs_events.rationale: the governing spec docs/specs/adr-054-notebook-dependency-analysis.md landed in PR 2228 and this change implements it without adding a documented surface

owner_directive: Implement ADR-054 spec 2 task T-007: the bounded content fingerprint with the declared size bound and the unobservable identity fallback (FR-024, FR-025, FR-029, SC-006, SC-007), in src/scistudio/explore/fingerprint.py with tests in tests/explore/test_fingerprint.py.
